question: Can an identified disagreement change an interim deliverable during a training measurement already chosen by the autonomous planner, without consuming an extra training fit or redirecting exploration?
development_replay: Run the first previously profiled ungraded task n71 once from scratch. Its training trajectory motivated this design. Show execution and final-prediction fidelity against its archived no-interruption run. Its outer truth does not exist and it is excluded from performance claims.
fresh_panel: Before looking at scores, generate n74 and n75 in this order with seeds 26174 and 26175, each with 300 training and 160 separately generated held-out examples of the same heterogeneous, noisy numeric binary family. Use balanced accuracy. Compare local unaltered search against scheduled review from empty run directories. No refitting or other data-driven change to this protocol after seeing performance.
policy: At the first eligible scheduled training-fold confirmation following a ranking reversal, allow a single campus DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decision. It may decline or preregister the two distinct interim publication actions and an attainable threshold before the measurement. The planned confirmation and full downstream search proceed independently. Keep current delivery if the decision is unavailable, invalid or fails its own test.
outcomes: Freeze and independently reload the final models on every task. For each triggered task, reload actual pre/post pointers and compare with the ordinary control at exactly that trial. Verify actual action, prediction rows changed, model availability, full search actions, physical fit counts, elapsed request time, and ledger. If no trigger, report that explicitly. A preliminary performance signal requires one fresh interim improvement, no fresh interim regression where measured and no final regression. With two fresh tasks this cannot establish generalization or justify automatic promotion.
resources: Same split seed, 16 actual fits including final refits and 600 seconds per cold path. At most 5 paths, 80 actual fits and three requests total (one per canonical task, at most RMB 0.12 each), same local outbox, no retry and stop further calls for unresolved usage. No released test data or labels in the runtime.
